endpoints.title: Create Interaction
endpoints.description:
Use an application command, a component on a bot's message, or submit a form the bot opened. The server checks every value and permission, then sends the interaction to the bot only. The answer arrives as `InteractionStateUpdate` plus a channel message, a message update, `EphemeralMessageCreate` or `InteractionModal`, for this user.

Sending the same `nonce` again returns the first interaction.

verification.test: interactions: bots cannot create interactions

endpoints.title: Respond to Interaction
endpoints.description:
First answer of the bot, authenticated by the interaction token. It must arrive before `respond_by` and can only happen once.

- `Message`: reply now; `data.ephemeral` makes it visible to the invoking user only, and it is never stored as a channel message. - `DeferredMessage`: show that the bot is working; finish later with `PATCH /interactions/<id>/<token>/original` before the token expires. - `UpdateMessage` / `DeferredUpdate` (components and forms opened from one): change the message the component is on, now or later. - `Modal`: open a form for the user (not as an answer to a form). - `AutocompleteResult` (autocomplete only): up to 25 suggestions.

verification.test: interactions: full round trip with the interaction token

endpoints.title: Send Follow-up
endpoints.description: Another message for the same interaction, after the first answer (or while it is deferred). At most 5 per interaction.

verification.test: interactions: full round trip with the interaction token

endpoints.title: Delete Interaction Message
endpoints.description: Delete the first answer or a follow-up by its message id. For private messages the invoking user's clients receive `EphemeralMessageDelete`.

verification.test: interactions: full round trip with the interaction token

endpoints.description: Edit the first answer or a follow-up by its message id.

endpoints.title: Fetch Server Commands
endpoints.description: Commands a member can pick from in this server: those of every bot installed here, global or limited to this server. Commands that need server permissions the member lacks, or that the server's command permission rules keep from them, are left out. With `channel`, the channel rules count too (a thread or forum post uses its channel's); the channel is checked again when a command is used.
